title: US-05 DFD: list fridge contents

flows.label: Owned ingredient names and original addedAt
200 complete ingredient list or empty list/error

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
An empty array is a successful empty-fridge result and the UI shows a clear empty state.
A list read does not write inventory or change original addedAt; display labels are addition dates.
